# OverCue Desktop 2.2.66 for Windows

- **DJM-900NXS2 Stems EQ** is now available as a preview. Select DJM-900NXS2 under Mixers and choose the official 2.08 update file to create the patched update on your computer. After installation the mixer reports version 2.09.
- On the 900NXS2, LOW controls Drums, MID controls Vocals, and HIGH controls Harmonics / Other. Requires prepared stems and OverCue CDJ-3000 firmware 1.0.1 or later. To return to stock, reinstall the official 2.08 update.
